subject: error loading rstan from library on network drive in Windows

messages.author: 6b3dfa6c2646a8c1
messages.subject: error loading rstan from library on network drive in Windows
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to load the rstan from a library stored Windows network drive, in order to run Stan from a Windows cluster.

I am able to load rstan fine from a personal library on the C:/ drive:

  > .libPaths("C:/R/library")
> .libPaths()
[1] "C:/R/library"                       "C:/Program Files/R/R-3.2.2/library"
> library(rstan)
Loading required package: Rcpp
Loading required package: inline

Attaching package: ‘inline’

The following object is masked from ‘package:Rcpp’:
  
  registerPlugin

rstan (Version 2.7.0-1, packaged: 2015-07-17 18:12:01 UTC, GitRev: 05c3d0058b6a)
For execution on a local, multicore CPU with excess RAM we recommend calling
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
> sessionInfo()
R version 3.2.2 (2015-08-14)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)
Running under: Windows 7 x64 (build 7601) Service Pack 1

locale:
  [1] LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252  LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252   
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252 LC_NUMERIC=C                          
[5] LC_TIME=English_United States.1252    

attached base packages:
  [1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
  [1] rstan_2.7.0-1 inline_0.3.14 Rcpp_0.12.0  

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
  [1] stats4_3.2.2
> 


But when I try to load from a mapped network drive (to drive letter Q: below), it throws an error: "Error : .onAttach failed in attachNamespace() for 'rstan', details:"


> .libPaths("Q:/R/library")
> .libPaths()
[1] "Q:/R/library"                       "C:/Program Files/R/R-3.2.2/library"
> library(rstan)
Loading required package: Rcpp
Loading required package: inline

Attaching package: ‘inline’

The following object is masked from ‘package:Rcpp’:
  
  registerPlugin

Error : .onAttach failed in attachNamespace() for 'rstan', details:
  call: pkgdesc$Packaged
error: $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors
In addition: Warning message:
  In packageDescription("rstan", lib.loc = rstanLib) :
  no package 'rstan' was found
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘rstan’
> sessionInfo()
R version 3.2.2 (2015-08-14)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)
Running under: Windows 7 x64 (build 7601) Service Pack 1

locale:
  [1] LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252 
[2] LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252   
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252
[4] LC_NUMERIC=C                          
[5] LC_TIME=English_United States.1252    

attached base packages:
  [1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
  [1] inline_0.3.14 Rcpp_0.12.0  

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
  [1] rstan_2.7.0-1 stats4_3.2.2 
> 


Rcpp and inline load fine, it’s just rstan that throws the error. The result is the same whether I provide the address via the mapped network drive letter or the full network path.

I appreciate any advice.

Many thanks,
Jeff

messages.author: 6b3dfa6c2646a8c1
messages.subject: Re: error loading rstan from library on network drive in Windows
parts:
I'm none the wiser for why, but fiddling some permissions seems to have sorted this.

Thanks,
Jeff
